audit_title: PCVC Phase 6 Final Metric Validation & Scientific Evaluation

verified_oracle_distribution.nature: Binary step function with extreme class imbalance (98.3% positive).

part_1_mrr_audit.critical_bottleneck_definition_problem: When ~39 out of 40 candidates possess identical maximum impact (delta_ARL = 1.0), designating a single 'top bottleneck' is mathematically ill-posed.
part_1_mrr_audit.previous_mrr_artifact: The previously reported MRR values (B6 = 0.5510, B3 = 1.0000) arose because ties were broken using Critical Accessibility Dependency (CAD) as a secondary sort key, creating an artificial ranking alignment.

tie_sensitivity_test_1000_iterations.methodology: For identical delta_ARL maximum ties, the target bottleneck was selected uniformly at random across 1,000 iterations over 10 evaluation seeds.

part_1_mrr_audit.verdict: MRR IS NOT A VALID PRIMARY METRIC FOR THIS BINARY ORACLE. When ties are broken without bias, all baselines converge to the theoretical uniform random expectation ~0.107.

part_2_recall_audit.nature_of_current_implementation: Fraction of a CAD-sorted pseudo-top-10 retrieved. When oracle ties are broken by CAD, this reduces to measuring alignment with CAD.

formal_definitions_comparison.positive_impact_recall_at_10: (# predicted top-10 edges with delta_ARL > 0) / (# all positive-impact oracle edges)
formal_definitions_comparison.mathematical_bound: Since |OracleCriticalSet| = 39.1 on average, maximum possible Recall@10 is 10 / 39.1 = 0.2558 (25.58%) for ANY method.

part_5_prioritization_discrimination_ver.question: Can any ranking method meaningfully outperform random under this oracle?
part_5_prioritization_discrimination_ver.answer: NO. The current VIT graph and delta_ARL definition provide insufficient oracle class imbalance for strong prioritization evaluation.
part_5_prioritization_discrimination_ver.scientific_statement: Because 98.29% of edges have delta_ARL = 1.0, uniform random selection achieves Precision@10 = 100%, Recall@10 = 25.6%, and Average Precision = 0.99. No prioritization method can statistically prove superiority on a task where almost all items are positive targets.

case_a_current_delta_arl.formula: delta_ARL(u, v) = ARL_orig(u, v) - ARL_cf(u, v) without paths

case_b_arl_with_candidate_paths.formula: delta_ARL(u, v) with candidate_paths supplied via Yen shortest simple paths

alternative_a_detour_delta_meters.formula: delta_d(u, v) = dist_{G - e}(u, v) - length(u, v)
alternative_a_detour_delta_meters.description: Physical wheelchair detour distance imposed if edge fails. Naturally separates critical bottlenecks from easily bypassable segments.

GREEN: Alternative A: Physical Detour Impact (delta_d in meters) [Recommended Future Oracle]
YELLOW: Spearman rank correlation (rho) [Usable as secondary diagnostic of score monotonicity]
RED: NDCG@K (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain) [Degenerate ceiling at 1.000]
MRR (Mean Reciprocal Rank under binary delta_ARL) [Collapses to uniform random ~0.107 under unbiased ties]
Precision@K [Degenerate ceiling at 100% due to 98.3% base rate]
Recall@K under binary delta_ARL [Mathematically bounded at K/M = 25.6% for all baselines]
Average Precision (AP) under binary delta_ARL [Random achieves 0.99, non-discriminative]
Mean Rank / Median Rank of Critical Set [Identically ~20.0 for all baselines]

supported_claims: PCVC successfully models profile-differentiated accessibility uncertainty across campus networks (E1).
Mobility impairment creates dramatic, quantifiable routing cost increases (1.75x for wheelchairs) (E4).
Closed-loop safe-return probe trajectories are 100% feasible for all profiles with minimal detour (+2.3% for wheelchairs) (E5, E6).
Multi-loss objective terms are non-redundant and computationally scalable (0.1 ms ranking, 5.89 s pipeline) (E7, E8, E9).
unsupported_claims: Prioritization superiority of PCVC over Random cannot be demonstrated under the current delta_ARL oracle because 98.29% of edges have positive impact, causing Random to achieve identical metric performance.
final_scientific_verdict.smallest_required_modification: Adopt Physical Detour Delta (delta_d in meters) as the counterfactual oracle ground truth for E2 and E3 benchmarking in future revisions.
